VERDICT: do-now
WHY: The 2026.8.2 notes literally say the managed Sharp dependency update is "fixing vulnerabilities in image decoding," which is an explicit security fix, and 2026.9.1 adds further hardening around ingress, token, and secret-redaction boundaries. On top of that, 2026.8.1 ships two labeled breaking migrations (removal of the bundled OpenProse plugin and the codex/openai-codex to openai/* route migration) that require `openclaw doctor --fix` to complete.
WHAT_IT_WILL_TAKE: Back up configuration and state first, then run the update followed by `openclaw doctor --fix` to complete the OpenProse cleanup and OpenAI route migration (flagged conflicts need manual repair), and verify the Gateway starts cleanly - effectively a deliberate migration window, not a routine container recreation.

Also known issue: standalone memory-lancedb installs can still resolve older vulnerable Sharp. v2026.9.1 has security-ish fixes (ingress/token safety, secrets redaction) but not explicitly "security issue" — they're hardening fixes.

Verdict: do-now.
